apps.name: Evently
apps.tagline: The Unified Campus Event Discovery & Telemetry Hub
apps.text: A comprehensive mobile companion for New Horizon students featuring real-time event schedules, interactive maps, seat availability counters, and push notification reminders.
features: Live QR ticket verification at auditorium gates
Personalized timetable integration with Google Calendar
Offline-first cached schedules with instant background sync
Real-time announcements from student committee chairs
apps.metrics: Used by 450+ students during TechSync'24 with 99.8% uptime.

apps.name: Treasure-hunt App
apps.tagline: Augmented Reality & Geofenced Campus Quest Engine
apps.text: An immersive physical-digital hybrid puzzle platform. Participants navigate campus coordinates using real-time GPS telemetry, AR marker reveals, and cipher decryption challenges.
features: Geofenced checkpoint unlocks within 5-meter radius accuracy
Interactive 3D camera overlays for digital token collection
Cryptographic cipher validation engine preventing spoofing
Real-time synchronized leaderboard broadcasted to live stage
apps.metrics: Powered 60+ competing teams with zero GPS drift failure.
